item.title: U.S. 30-year bond yield rises to highest since 2004 as selloff deepens
item.description: Long-dated US borrowing costs climbed to their highest level in more than 20 years on Thursday as the months-long selloff in bond markets gathered pace.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Long-dated US borrowing costs climbed to their highest level in more than 20 years on Thursday as the months-long selloff in bond markets gathered pace. The yield on the 30-year US Treasury bond climbed more than 3 basis points to 5.444%, its highest since 2004, as prices fell. US and global yields jumped on Wednesday after [USN:L6N45F0Y8 TEXT:"data pointed to"] strong US growth and rising inflation pressures, causing traders to increase their bets on Federal Reserve rate hikes. Bonds around the world have been under pressure for months as the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran has pushed up energy prices, growth has proved resilient and investors have fretted about high levels of government debt.

item.title: Institutos alemanes revisan al alza las previsiones de crecimiento económico para 2026 y 2027
item.description: Los principales institutos económicos de Alemania revisaron al alza el jueves sus previsiones de crecimiento para la mayor economía de Europa para este año y el próximo, señalando que la economía se comportó notablemente mejor en el primer semestre de 2026 de lo que se había previsto en primavera.
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez
item.content:encoded: Los principales institutos económicos de Alemania revisaron al alza el jueves sus previsiones de crecimiento para la mayor economía de Europa para este año y el próximo, señalando que la economía se comportó notablemente mejor en el primer semestre de 2026 de lo que se había previsto en primavera. Se prevé que la economía alemana crezca un 1,3% en 2026, frente a la previsión anterior del 0,6%. Para 2027, los institutos prevén un crecimiento del 1,1%, frente a la proyección anterior del 0,9%. Las cifras confirman un informe de Reuters publicado el martes. "La economía se ha desarrollado con más solidez de lo esperado. Sin embargo, la recuperación se asienta sobre una base frágil, ya que los elevados precios de la energía y los problemas estructurales siguen lastrando la actividad económica", afirmó Oliver Holtemoeller, del Instituto de Investigación Económica de Halle (IWH). La economía alemana lleva recuperándose desde finales de 2025, pero el repunte, aunque más fuerte de lo previsto en primavera, sigue siendo modesto, según los institutos. Los institutos prevén un crecimiento de solo el 0,4% en 2028. Se prevé que la expansión económica pierda impulso en 2028, ya que se verá limitada por factores estructurales: la población activa se está reduciendo debido al cambio demográfico y el crecimiento potencial sigue disminuyendo, según los economistas. La atonía de la economía alemana ha sido un tema importante en las recientes elecciones regionales del país, que se han saldado con grandes avances para la extrema derecha y la extrema izquierda. La recuperación económica se ralentizó temporalmente en el tercer trimestre, según los institutos. Aunque los indicadores de confianza siguen mejorando, los últimos datos económicos concretos han sido más débiles. Aunque la crisis de los precios de la energía asociada a la guerra de Irán ha lastrado la economía, el aumento de los precios de los combustibles para vehículos y del gasóleo de calefacción apenas ha tenido, hasta ahora, un efecto de contagio en los precios al consumo en general, según los economistas. No obstante, los institutos prevén que la inflación aumente hasta el 2,8% en 2026 y el 3,2% en 2027, antes de descender al 2,0% en 2028. Es probable que el mercado laboral reaccione con cierto retraso: se espera que el empleo siga disminuyendo por el momento, mientras que se prevé que la tasa de desempleo baje del 6,4% en 2026 al 6,2% en 2027 y al 5,8% en 2028. Las previsiones han sido elaboradas conjuntamente por cinco prestigiosos institutos económicos: el RWI de Essen, el Instituto Ifo de Múnich, el IfW de Kiel, el IWH de Halle y el DIW de Berlín.

item.title: Bank of America plans additional apprentice hiring
item.description: Bank of America said on Thursday it plans to hire 1,000 additional apprentices over the next two years, expanding its skills-based hiring in local communities.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of America (BAC.N) said on Thursday it plans to hire 1,000 additional apprentices over the next two years, expanding its skills-based hiring in local communities. The commitment is on top of the more than 800 apprentices the company already hires each year through programs across its consumer banking, technology and other business areas. The additional hires will target workers without a four-year college degree. As part of the initiative, Bank of America will invest $150 million over five years in workforce development organizations that help individuals gain job-ready skills and connect with employment opportunities, the company said. The bank also said the funding would support local organizations, universities, community colleges and nonprofit groups focused on workforce training.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die führenden Wirtschaftsforschungsinstitute sind für die nächste Zeit mit Blick auf die deutsche Konjunktur zuversichtlicher - schauen aber ernüchtert auf 2028. Sie erhöhten ihre Wachstumsprognose für das Bruttoinlandsprodukt (BIP) in diesem Jahr auf 1,3 Prozent und auf 1,1 Prozent für 2027, wie am Donnerstag aus dem gemeinsamen Herbstgutachten der Institute hervorgeht. "Allerdings ist der Aufschwung nicht besonders kräftig", sagte Konjunkturchef Oliver Holtemöller vom Leibniz-Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung Halle. Die Institute erwarten für 2028 nur noch ein Wachstum von 0,4 Prozent. "Die Wachstumskräfte schwinden weiter", sagte Stefan Kooths vom Kieler Forschungsinstitut IfW. Die aktuellen Probleme seien vor allem struktureller Art, deswegen müsse es Reformen geben. Die Regierung dürfe nicht im Quartalsrhythmus Reformen beschließen und dann wieder aufschnüren, kritisierte Kooths. Denn dies führe zur Zurückhaltung von Investoren und sorge für fehlende Impulse von privaten Investitionen. Die unklare Wirtschaftspolitik der Koalition von Union und SPD habe ihren Anteil an der insgesamt schwachen Konjunktur in Deutschland. "Die Stimmung ist schlechter als die Lage", ergänzte Holtemöller. Es brauche hier mehr Vertrauen bei Firmen und Verbrauchern. AUFSCHWUNG MIT ANGEZOGENER HANDBREMSE "Die Wirtschaft hat sich robuster entwickelt als erwartet", erklärte Holtemöller zur Erhöhung der Prognosen für 2026 und 2027. "Der Aufschwung steht jedoch auf einem schmalen Fundament, denn hohe Energiepreise und Strukturprobleme belasten." Im laufenden Sommer-Quartal bremse zudem Niedrigwasser die Aktivität der Wirtschaft vorübergehend. "Das staatliche Defizit nimmt weiter zu, sodass sich ein wachsender Konsolidierungsbedarf aufstaut." Im April hatten die Ökonomen und Regierungsberater noch damit gerechnet, dass das BIP 2026 nur um 0,6 Prozent steigt und im kommenden Jahr um 0,9 Prozent zulegt. "Die Erholung fällt stärker aus als noch im Frühjahr erwartet, bleibt aber schwach", hieß es. Vor allem die Exporte und die Wertschöpfung im verarbeitenden Gewerbe legten im ersten Halbjahr überraschend stark zu. "Impulse kamen von der robusten Weltkonjunktur und dem weltweiten KI-Boom." Die Experten betonten aber: "Unternehmensinvestitionen und der private Konsum blieben dagegen schwach." NUR STROHFEUER? Die Gemeinschaftsdiagnose trägt den Namen "Aufschwung mit Strukturproblemen - Finanzpolitik auf Abwegen". Mit Blick auf die Alterung der Gesellschaft und die teurere Energie sagte Holtemöller: "Wir haben zwei Mega-Baustellen." Sollte die Regierung dies nicht angehen, dürfte sich die Lage kaum bessern. Der Konjunkturchef des Ifo-Instituts, Timo Wollmershäuser, ergänzte, dies führe bei den deutschen Firmen vor allem zu einem Kostenproblem und werfe sie im internationalen Wettbewerb zurück. Viele Ökonomen fürchten, dass die Sonderschulden mit staatlichen Mehrausgaben für Infrastruktur und Verteidigung nur zu einem konjunkturellen Strohfeuer führen, sollten nachhaltige Reformen ausbleiben. Allein aus demografischen Gründen werde Deutschland mittel- und langfristig niedrigere Wachstumsraten bekommen, sagte Holtemöller. Die Prognose wird im Auftrag des Bundeswirtschaftsministeriums vom Ifo München, dem DIW Berlin, dem RWI Essen, dem IfW Kiel und dem IWH Halle erstellt.

item.title: H&M mejora su utilidad operativa, pero las ventas siguen estancadas
item.description: La cadena sueca de moda H&M anunció el jueves una utilidad operativa en el tercer trimestre superior a la esperada, y su director ejecutivo, Daniel Erver, dijo que sus medidas para controlar los costos y mejorar la eficiencia en el abastecimiento estaban dando sus frutos.
item.dc:creator: Greta Fondahn, Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: La cadena sueca de moda H&M (HMb.ST) anunció el jueves una utilidad operativa en el tercer trimestre superior a la esperada, y su director ejecutivo, Daniel Erver, dijo que sus medidas para controlar los costos y mejorar la eficiencia en el abastecimiento estaban dando sus frutos. Desde que Erver asumió el cargo de director ejecutivo en enero de 2024, la rentabilidad de H&M ha mejorado, pero los inversionistas siguen a la espera de señales que indiquen que puede impulsar el crecimiento de las ventas frente a la feroz competencia de Shein (0625.HK) e Inditex (ITX.MC) , propietaria de Zara. La utilidad operativa de H&M en el tercer trimestre fiscal aumentó hasta los 6.040 millones de coronas suecas (608,63 millones de dólares), frente a los 4.910 millones de coronas del año anterior, y superó la previsión media de 5.140 millones de coronas, según una encuesta de LSEG a analistas. El margen bruto de H&M se amplió hasta el 54,0% en el trimestre, frente al 52,9% del año anterior, gracias en parte a las devoluciones de aranceles. Los analistas esperaban un margen del 53,4%. No obstante, las ventas siguieron siendo débiles, y H&M indicó que las ventas de septiembre aumentarían un 1% en monedas locales, la misma tasa de crecimiento que en el trimestre de junio a agosto. Las acciones de H&M bajaban un 2% al inicio de la sesión. "Siguen teniendo dificultades para impulsar el crecimiento de las ventas", señaló el analista de Inderes Lucas Mattsson, quien añadió que las utilidades estaban "relativamente en línea" con las expectativas del mercado, una vez ajustadas por los efectos de la devolución de aranceles. H&M está aumentando la proporción de ropa que compra durante la temporada, en un intento por reaccionar más rápidamente a las tendencias de la moda y a unas condiciones meteorológicas cada vez más impredecibles. Sin embargo, las existencias aumentaron un 9% en términos ajustados al tipo de cambio durante el trimestre, lo que, según H&M, se debió a las perturbaciones en las cadenas de suministro mundiales. La empresa también está invirtiendo en logística a medida que crecen las ventas en línea, y ha anunciado que este año y el próximo empezará a utilizar gradualmente nuevos almacenes en Europa para mejorar su capacidad y la disponibilidad de productos. Mientras tanto, los herederos multimillonarios del fundador de H&M, Erling Persson, han ido aumentando discretamente su participación, lo que ha alimentado las especulaciones de que podrían acabar sacando el grupo de bolsa. (1 dólar = 9,9239 coronas suecas)

item.content:encoded: Mit dem heraufziehenden Wirtschaftsaufschwung ist die Stimmung in den Chefetagen der deutschen Unternehmen auf den höchsten Stand seit Mai 2023 gestiegen. Der Ifo-Geschäftsklimaindex kletterte im September auf 89,9 Punkte, nach 88,8 Zählern im August und damit zum fünften Mal in Folge. Das teilte das Münchner Ifo-Institut am Donnerstag zu seiner Umfrage unter rund 9000 Führungskräften mit. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters befragte Experten hatten mit 89,0 Punkten gerechnet. Die Unternehmen bewerteten ihre aktuelle Geschäftslage positiver. Auch ihre Erwartungen hellten sich weiter auf. "Der Aufschwung nimmt langsam Fahrt auf", sagte Ifo-Umfragechef Klaus [USN:L8N45G0GE TEXT:"Wohlrabe"] im Gespräch mit der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Der Anstieg passt in ein Konjunkturbild, welches sich zunehmend aufhellt", erklärte LBBW-Analyst Jens-Oliver Niklasch. Der Auftragsbestand habe in den vergangenen Monaten deutlich zugelegt, und dies mache sich jetzt auch stärker bei den befragten Unternehmen in der Breite bemerkbar. Im Verarbeitenden Gewerbe konnte das Ifo-Barometer erneut zulegen und auch im Handel ging es nach oben. Im Dienstleistungssektor drehte das Geschäftsklima wieder in den positiven Bereich. Nur im Bauhauptgewerbe blieb der Ifo-Index nahezu unverändert. Zuletzt hatte die [USN:L8N45F0JV TEXT:"Umfrage"] des Finanzdienstleisters S&P Global unter Einkaufsmanagern das stärkste Wachstum der deutschen Wirtschaft seit elf Monaten signalisiert. Die führenden [USN:L8N45G0ET TEXT:"Wirtschaftsforschungsinstitute"] rechnen in ihrem Herbstgutachten damit, dass das Bruttoinlandsprodukt dieses Jahr um 1,3 Prozent zulegen wird. Das Ifo veranschlagt mit 1,4 Prozent sogar einen Tick mehr Wachstum. Die deutsche Wirtschaft sei widerstandsfähiger als gedacht, meint Commerzbank-Chefvolkswirt Jörg Krämer. Allerdings zeichne sich trotzdem nur eine moderate Erholung ab. "Denn wegen der fehlenden durchgreifenden Reformen verbessert sich die geschundene Standortqualität nicht entscheidend, weshalb die Unternehmen sich mit Investitionen hierzulande weiter zurückhalten dürften."

item.title: Gulf shares slip on regional uncertainty, shipping concerns
item.description: Major Gulf equity markets fell in early trade on Thursday as little progress in US-Iran diplomacy and persistent risks to Strait of Hormuz shipping unsettled investors.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Major Gulf equity markets fell in early trade on Thursday as little progress in US-Iran diplomacy and persistent risks to Strait of Hormuz shipping unsettled investors. Concerns mounted after Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, [USN:S8N422078 TEXT:"warned in a state television interview"] on Wednesday that, should neighbouring countries cooperate with Washington to halt Iranian flights, Tehran would ensure that their airports "cannot function." Despite continued diplomatic engagement, divisions between Tehran and Washington over ending the conflict [USN:L1N45F09P TEXT:"remain substantial"]. A senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday that diplomacy must continue, even as Iran's president told the UN General Assembly that the country would not yield to US pressure. Geopolitical uncertainty continued to [USN:L1N45G040 TEXT:"disrupt shipping"] through the Strait of Hormuz, where 10 commodity vessels transited on Wednesday, up from seven a day earlier but well below the 10-day average of about 17. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index (.TASI) eased 0.1%, hit by a 1% slide in Al Rajhi Bank (1120.SE) . Dubai's main share index (.DFMGI) was down 0.2%, with top lender Emirates NBD (ENBD.DU) losing 0.7%. In Abu Dhabi, the index (.FTFADGI) fell 0.1%. Meanwhile, the UAE central bank on Wednesday [USN:L1N45F0FR TEXT:"suspended"] Iran's Bank Melli from operating in the country, underscoring deteriorating ties between the two nations since the US war on Iran began in February. The Qatari index (.QSI) lost 0.4%.

item.title: Amazon bets $3 billion on India's fast-delivery boom, sources say
item.description: US e-commerce retailer Amazon will invest $3 billion to expand its India quick commerce business by 2030, two sources said, its biggest bet yet on a sector where rivals have raced ahead by popularising deliveries within minutes.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Kalra, Greg Bensinger
item.content:encoded: US e-commerce retailer Amazon (AMZN.O) will invest $3 billion to expand its India quick commerce business by 2030, two sources said, its biggest bet yet on a sector where rivals have raced ahead by popularising deliveries within minutes. The instant deliveries sector, dubbed "quick commerce", has become a rapidly growing force and reshaped how urban Indians shop for everything from milk and chocolates to iPhones and electronics, which were once only bought from retail stores or major e-commerce websites where deliveries took time. Walmart's (WMT.O) Flipkart and Amazon, which dominate India's e-commerce space, are [USN:L4N42V0LI TEXT:"late entrants in quick commerce"]. The $19 billion sector is set to more than double in size to $41 billion by 2030, according to Datum Intelligence. Amazon plans to invest $1 billion in the quick commerce sector by the end of 2027, and another $2 billion by 2030, two people with direct knowledge of the plans said. The planned investment has not previously been reported. Amazon declined to comment on the planned investment numbers. The retailer, however, said its quick commerce business has crossed $1 billion in annualised gross sales over the past three months, "making it the fastest-growing e-commerce business in Amazon India's history." MORE SMALL NEIGHBOURHOOD WAREHOUSES A key focus of the planned investment will be adding new small neighbourhood warehouses to the current Amazon Now service network from where deliveries are shipped quickly, said both sources, who declined to be identified as the plan is confidential. "Expansion needs money," the first source said. Amazon counts India as a key growth market, where it is expanding its data centre, cloud and e-commerce businesses. But it also faces India's tight regulations for foreign e-commerce companies and a pending 2024 [USN:L4N3KU0W6 TEXT:"case"] in which it was found by the antitrust watchdog to have given preference to select sellers in breach of the law — allegations it denies. The sector's rise since 2022 coincided with growing concerns about [USN:L4N2U02WM TEXT:"rider safety"] as bikers zip through residential areas to deliver orders fast. India's government in January ordered companies to [USN:L4N3YE11P TEXT:"stop"] promoting such operations as "10-minute" services. Domestic giants Eternal's (ETEA.NS) Blinkit, Swiggy (SWIG.NS) and IPO-bound Zepto control 77% of the market, together operating more than 4,500 stores, while Walmart's Flipkart has more than 1,000 and an 11% market share, Datum data shows. Amazon has only a 6.2% market share. The first source said Amazon was targeting around 1,300 stores by April next year, from around 750 now. DAILY ESSENTIALS FOCUS WITH CHALLENGES The other key areas of spending, the first person added, will be strengthening inventory management software at stores, deploying AI tools for demand prediction and expanding product selection. "The focus will be daily essentials. If the order is unlikely to be repeated, Amazon does not plan to stock it right now in quick commerce," said the person, explaining why Amazon does not stock iPhones like its quick commerce rivals. Bernstein in a July note warned that groceries alone cannot cover the high costs of quick commerce as average order values are low, and "non-grocery items carry higher prices and higher margins." Amazon does not agree with critics who say it missed the bus, one of the sources said. The company wanted to get the model right, such as having a cold storage room in each store and not just a refrigerator. Satish Meena, founder of Datum Intelligence, said it will not be easy for Amazon to catch up with rivals who offer quality service and have loyal customers, but it could lure their shopping website customers to fast deliveries. The Amazon Now service, which sits within the main Amazon app, is currently offering a 20% cashback discount on some initial orders above 499 rupees ($5.20), and free delivery above 99 rupees ($1) for select customers. "It took some time for Amazon to commit. There appears to be a realisation that this is a model they have to invest in," Meena said. "They are doing discounts, which can help lure current Amazon customers to quick commerce."

item.title: Fed's Williams says it is reasonable to see another US rate hike this year
item.description: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said on Thursday it was reasonable to think that the U.S. central bank might need to raise interest rates again before the end of the year to help bring down inflation risks.
item.dc:creator: David Milliken
item.content:encoded: New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said on Thursday it was reasonable to think that the U.S. central bank might need to raise interest rates again before the end of the year to help bring down inflation risks. Forecasts among market participants showed investors thought "it's likely that another rate hike may be appropriate by the end of the year. That seems to me a reasonable way of thinking about it," Williams said. "But we have to see. We're going to collect the data and do what we did between July and September" in assessing the information, he told a conference in London organised by the National Institute of Economic and Social Research, a think tank. Williams stressed the high levels of uncertainty clouding the economic outlook. The U.S. central bank under new Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh last week raised its policy rate to the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"3.75%-4.00% range"] and 16 of 18 policymakers signalled the Fed would probably need to deliver at least one more rate hike before the end of 2026. Williams — who also serves as vice-chair of the interest rate setting Federal Open Market Committee — said the US and other economies around the world had proven resilient to the shock of higher energy prices caused by the Iran war. But inflation posed the "big challenge" for policymakers seeking to balance growth and price risks. "We really want to see not only inflation get back to 2% which is absolutely essential to achieve that, but also we want to see that happen ... in a timely manner," Williams said. The Fed lifted rates last week to target inflation pressures that have overshot its 2% target for years and are building further on the back of President Donald Trump’s trade tariff agenda and the Middle East war. Fed officials now expect inflation will not be back at target until 2029. Futures markets are putting strong odds of another increase to borrowing costs at the Fed's October policy meeting, as well as another increase in December. Asked about the likely timing of the next rate hike, Williams noted that September's move had been triggered by a build-up of pressures rather than a sudden change in data.

item.title: Swiss National Bank says 90% CET1 backing for UBS a good outcome
item.description: A 90% Common Equity Tier 1 backing for UBS's foreign units is a good amount, SNB Vice Chairman Antoine Martin said on Thursday, a day after Switzerland's upper house of parliament voted on new banking regulations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A 90% Common Equity Tier 1 backing for UBS's (UBSG.S) foreign units is a good amount, SNB Vice Chairman Antoine Martin said on Thursday, a day after Switzerland's upper house of parliament [USN:L8N45F0DE TEXT:"voted"] on new banking regulations. More backing of foreign participations with CET1 capital is better from a financial stability perspective, Martin added, reiterating the central bank's previous position. Full backing with 100% CET1 capital would have been even better, Martin said.

item.title: In lieve calo per tensioni Medio Oriente, attesa colloqui Usa-Cina
item.description: L'azionario europeo registra un leggero calo, mentre gli investitori valutano le tensioni persistenti in Medio Oriente e attendono i colloqui tra Stati Uniti e Cina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'azionario europeo registra un leggero calo, mentre gli investitori valutano le tensioni persistenti in Medio Oriente e attendono i colloqui tra Stati Uniti e Cina. ** Intorno alle 10.00 l'indice paneuropeo Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) è in calo dello 0,03% a 639,74 punti. Anche la maggior parte delle borse regionali scambia in ribasso. ** Il sentiment degli investitori rimane cauto, poiché le tensioni geopolitiche in Medio Oriente mantengono volatili i mercati energetici. I funzionari iraniani hanno avuto contatti con gli inviati statunitensi all’Assemblea generale delle Nazioni Unite, ma entrambe le parti hanno segnalato scarsi progressi verso la fine del conflitto. ** I prezzi del petrolio salgono leggermente mentre gli operatori rivalutano i rischi sull'offerta legati al conflitto in Medio Oriente, con i futures sul Brent che si mantengono sopra la soglia chiave dei 100 dollari il barile. ** Il segmento energetico europeo (.SXEP) guadagna lo 0,7%, mentre quello aerospaziale e della difesa (.SXPARO) guida i cali settoriali, penalizzato da SAAB (SAABb.ST) e HENSOLDT (HAGG.DE) . ** L’attenzione è rivolta anche al vertice tra il presidente degli Stati Uniti Donald Trump e il presidente cinese Xi Jinping, con la speranza di progressi nelle relazioni commerciali. ** Tra i singoli titoli, SHELLY GROUP avanza del 4,5% dopo che SCHNEIDER (SCHN.PA) ha annunciato l’intenzione di lanciare un’offerta pubblica di acquisto da 1,2 miliardi di euro sul produttore bulgaro di dispositivi smart. ** Le azioni di H&M (HMb.ST) registrano un calo del 3% nonostante il gruppo svedese abbia riportato un aumento dell’utile operativo superiore alle attese nel periodo giugno-agosto.

item.title: Svezia, banca centrale mantiene tassi invariati all'1,75%
item.description: La banca centrale svedese ha mantenuto il tasso di riferimento invariato all’1,75% come da attese, ma ha affermato che in futuro il tasso di riferimento dovrebbe essere alzato in misura maggiore rispetto a quanto previsto nelle proiezioni di giugno.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La banca centrale svedese ha mantenuto il tasso di riferimento invariato all’1,75% come da attese, ma ha affermato che in futuro il tasso di riferimento dovrebbe essere alzato in misura maggiore rispetto a quanto previsto nelle proiezioni di giugno. "Se le prospettive relative all’inflazione e all’attività economica rimarranno invariate, si stima che i rialzi del tasso di riferimento inizieranno già quest’anno", si legge in un comunicato della Riksbank. Gli analisti intervistati da Reuters avevano previsto all'unanimità che questa volta non ci sarebbero state variazioni. La Riksbank è sempre più preoccupata dalla possibilità di un'accelerazione dell’inflazione dopo i dati oltre le attese registrati durante l’estate.

item.title: England should play to strengths instead of copying Spain's template, says Gordon
item.description: Winger Anthony Gordon believes England should abandon attempts to copy Spain's possession-based style of football and instead embrace their natural game by leaning more into physical strengths.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Winger Anthony Gordon believes England should abandon attempts to copy Spain's possession-based style of football and instead embrace their natural game by leaning more into physical strengths. Following England's [USN:L8N43H27V TEXT:"World Cup semi-final"] loss to Argentina in July, England manager Thomas Tuchel attracted a backlash after saying ball possession was [USN:L8N43I21U TEXT:""not in their DNA""] like Spain, where a passing-heavy approach is taught at all levels. Gordon, who moved to Spanish club [USN:L4N4241O4 TEXT:"Barcelona from Newcastle United"] in May, agreed with Tuchel and said on Wednesday that he was not sure English players could be taught in a similar way. "Culturally, it's not just that tournament (the World Cup) or that game (against Argentina) where we couldn't control a game," the 25-year-old told reporters ahead of England's Nations League match against Spain on Saturday. "As a nation we don't have that strength like the Spanish, where we control games like they do. It's not in us. I'm not sure it's something that can be taught. Playing in Spain I can speak with an educated view on the way they keep the ball. "It's much different than I've ever experienced in this country, so I'm not sure we can ever get that. We can definitely get better – or maybe go the other way and really play to our strengths, which is play physical, play direct football and on the counterattack." After hosting Spain at Wembley, England visit the Czech Republic and Croatia before playing the Czechs again at home. The remaining two fixtures of the Nations League group will be completed in November.

item.title: Mercato frammentato frena finanziamenti banche Ue - EBA
item.description: Il mercato bancario frammentato dell’Europa impedisce agli istituti di credito di raggiungere le dimensioni necessarie per finanziare le ambizioni del continente in materia di digitalizzazione, sicurezza economica e difesa, ha detto a Reuters il presidente dell'EBA, l’Autorità bancaria europea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il mercato bancario frammentato dell’Europa impedisce agli istituti di credito di raggiungere le dimensioni necessarie per finanziare le ambizioni del continente in materia di digitalizzazione, sicurezza economica e difesa, ha detto a Reuters il presidente dell'EBA, l’Autorità bancaria europea. Pur restando altamente capitalizzate e continuando a registrare utili solidi, le banche europee sono limitate da un mercato unico "non così unico come dovrebbe essere", ha osservato François-Louis Michaud in un'intervista rilasciata oggi. "Sappiamo che l’Europa deve finanziare tutte queste trasformazioni: la digitalizzazione, l'ambiente, la demografia, la sicurezza economica e la difesa", ha detto Michaud. "È una questione esistenziale per il futuro dell’Europa". La Commissione europea sta portando avanti un programma di competitività volto a mobilitare investimenti per la digitalizzazione, la difesa e la sicurezza economica, esplorando al contempo modalità per facilitare le operazioni bancarie transfrontaliere e approfondire il mercato unico dell’Unione. DIFFERENZE NAZIONALI COSTOSE Michaud ha detto che le fusioni non sono l’unica soluzione e che, dal punto di vista dell'EBA, un maggiore credito transfrontaliero e una maggiore integrazione finanziaria sono altrettanto importanti. Le differenze nei regimi fiscali, di insolvenza e di tutela dei consumatori continuano a rendere oneroso per le banche offrire prodotti standardizzati in tutta l’Unione e realizzare economie di scala, ha aggiunto.

item.title: Dominant North Korea on track for fourth under-20 Women's World Cup triumph
item.description: North Korea's best finish at the senior Women's World Cup was a 2007 quarterfinal, but at age-group level they have been the dominant force for a couple of decades and on Sunday will play Spain for a fourth under-20 global title.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea's best finish at the senior Women's World Cup was a 2007 quarterfinal, but at age-group level they have been the dominant force for a couple of decades and on Sunday will play Spain for a fourth under-20 global title. The 3-0 win over Colombia at the Stadion Miejski LKS in the Polish city of Lodz on Wednesday kept them on track to defend the title they won in the South American country two years ago. They missed the 2022 edition as North Korea continued its isolation against COVID-19 and the 2020 edition was cancelled because of the pandemic, so you would have to go back eight years for their last defeat at a Women's under-20 World Cup. That 1-0 quarterfinal loss to hosts France in 2018 ended their second title defence, but they have suffered no hiccups in Poland this month, cruising to the final having scored 16 goals in six matches and conceded none. "I'm so happy, but while I'm happy to win today, our aim is to win the World Cup," midfielder Choe Rim-jong told FIFA.com after scoring North Korea's second goal in Wednesday's semifinal win. That ambition is understandable given North Korea's pedigree in the tournament, which they first won as debutants in 2006 by crushing China 5-0 in the final. If they beat 2022 champions Spain in Lodz on Sunday, they would become the first team to win the under-20 title back-to-back. North Korea have also won four of the nine editions of the under-17 World Cup and will go for a third straight title in Morocco next month. That has ensured a steady stream of talent flowing into the under-20 team with the overwhelming majority of the squad for the Poland tournament being under-17 World Cup winners in 2024. That includes attacking midfielder Jon Il-chong, whose playmaking was again instrumental in the win over Colombia on Wednesday. That progression of talent also augurs well for the senior North Korea team, who will end their absence from the Women's World Cup next year after doping bans, disappointing results and the global pandemic kept them away for 16 years. "Yes, I think our players can play in a senior Women's World Cup in the future," under-20 coach Han Chol-hak said after Jon won the Player of the Match in the Round of 16 win over Japan.

item.title: India's Navitas Solar to invest over $1 billion in clean energy expansion
item.description: India's privately owned solar modules maker Navitas Solar said on Thursday it plans to invest 100 billion rupees ($1.04 billion) over the next five years in Gujarat and Maharashtra to build an integrated clean energy business.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's privately owned solar modules maker Navitas Solar said on Thursday it plans to invest 100 billion rupees ($1.04 billion) over the next five years in Gujarat and Maharashtra to build an integrated clean energy business. Here are some more details from the company's statement: The investment will fund expansion into solar ingots, wafers, cells and modules, as well as battery energy storage systems and renewable power generation. The company said it is already building a 2.4 gigawatt solar cell plant in Sisodara, Gujarat. The first phase, involving about 12 billion rupees of investment, is targeted to start operations by July 2027. It also plans a 5 gigawatt-hour battery storage facility in Vadodara. In the state of Maharashtra, Navitas is developing 200-megawatt and 25-megawatt solar parks. Navitas currently has 3 GW of annual solar module manufacturing capacity, and said the expansion would broaden its presence in India's clean energy sector. ($1 = 95.8950 Indian rupees)

item.title: Serbia's Russian-owned NIS oil firm seeks new US sanctions waiver
item.description: Serbia's Russian-owned NIS , which runs the country's only oil refinery, said on Thursday that it has applied for a new US sanctions waiver to continue operations after September 30, when the current one expires.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Serbia's Russian-owned NIS (NIIS.BEL) , which runs the country's only oil refinery, said on Thursday that it has applied for a new US sanctions waiver to continue operations after September 30, when the current one expires. The US Office of Foreign Assets Control imposed sanctions against NIS last October over its Russian ownership, part of broader measures targeting Moscow's energy sector over its invasion of Ukraine. A new waiver would allow NIS, which supplies up to 80% of the Serbian market and is majority owned by Russia’s Gazprom Neft (SIBN.MM) and Gazprom (GAZP.MM) , to continue importing crude oil until the planned sale of the Russian stake to Hungarian oil and gas company MOL (MOLB.BU) . NIS said in a statement that "the regular functioning of the ... oil refinery, and a stable market supply are of crucial importance for maintaining energy stability" in Serbia. Washington has been pushing for the divestment of the Russian stake, and NIS has secured a series of temporary waivers until the sale is completed. Gazprom Neft and Gazprom have a combined 56.16% stake in NIS, while Serbia has 29.9% and the rest is owned by small shareholders and employees.

item.title: MLB roundup: Padres climb to top of crowded NL wild-card standings
item.description: Manny Machado homered and drove in three runs as the San Diego Padres moved to the brink of their third consecutive playoff appearance with a 5-1 road victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manny Machado homered and drove in three runs as the San Diego Padres moved to the brink of their third consecutive playoff appearance with a 5-1 road victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday. Fernando Tatis Jr. had three hits as the Padres reduced their magic number for clinching a National League wild-card spot to one. San Diego sits in the top NL wild-card position, one game ahead of both the Chicago Cubs and the Philadelphia Phillies. San Diego won for the 14th time in its past 16 games while coming out on top for just the fourth time in 12 games against Los Angeles this season. The Padres have never reached the playoffs in three consecutive seasons. In his return to the roster after recovering from knee and biceps injuries, Shohei Ohtani went 1-for-4 with a walk as the Dodgers saw their 11-game home winning streak end. Andy Pages and Teoscar Hernandez each had three hits while Los Angeles ace Yoshinobu Yamamoto (14-9) gave up four runs (two earned) on five hits over six innings. Brewers 4, Phillies 1 Brice Turang and Christian Yelich hit early home runs as visiting Milwaukee topped Philadelphia. William Contreras knocked in two runs for the Brewers, who extended their franchise-record win total. Milwaukee needs to capture one of its final four games to reach 100 victories for the first time in team history. Logan Henderson (11-3) allowed one run in five innings. Philadelphia starter Aaron Nola (7-11) permitted four runs and four hits in six innings. Bryson Stott doubled twice for the Phillies, who have a magic number of two to clinch a playoff berth. Marlins 3, Cubs 2 Esteury Ruiz's hustle enabled visiting Miami to score the go-ahead run in the seventh inning, leading to a win over Chicago. After a video review, Ruiz was declared safe at second base on what was originally ruled an inning-ending double play, with Agustin Ramirez scoring to break a 2-2 tie. Cade Gibson (6-2) threw one perfect inning, and ace Sandy Alcantara recorded his second save. Cubs starter Kevin Gausman allowed two runs in 5 2/3 innings, exiting after hurting his left shoulder while diving to make a tag at third base. Dansby Swanson hit a two-run single in the bottom of the sixth after Kyle Stowers socked a two-run homer in the top of the frame. Diamondbacks 5, Rockies 3 Tim Tawa homered, Gabriel Moreno had three hits and Arizona continued its drive for a postseason berth with a win over Colorado in Denver. The Diamondbacks have won four straight to move within three games of the Phillies and the Cubs in the chase for the last two NL wild-card positions with four games to play. Arizona starter Merrill Kelly (10-14) allowed two runs on four hits in 5 1/3 innings. Ezequiel Tovar homered and finished with two hits for the Rockies, who lost for the 14th time in 16 games. Rookie Mason Adams (0-2) struck out a career-high eight over a career-best six innings. He yielded four runs, all unearned, on five hits. Mariners 6, Astros 5 (10 innings) Josh Naylor lined a one-out single to center field with the bases loaded in the bottom of the 10th inning to score the deciding run as Seattle kept its slim playoff hopes alive with a victory against visiting Houston. Dominic Canzone drove in three runs for the Mariners, whose only chance to make the postseason is to finish in a three-way tie with Houston and Texas, who are tied atop the American League West. Julio Rodriguez's bases-loaded walk tied the game before Naylor's winning hit. Yainer Diaz hit a tiebreaking triple in the top of the 10th inning after earlier belting a two-run homer for the Astros. Houston closer Josh Hader (4-2) took the loss. Mets 7, Rangers 2 Marcus Semien damaged his former team's playoff hopes when he hit a tiebreaking solo homer in the eighth inning to help New York prevail in Arlington, Texas. Juan Soto socked a two-run homer in the third and Brett Baty added insurance with a pinch-hit grand slam in the ninth for the Mets. New York starter Nolan McLean (12-10) gave up two runs in seven innings. The Rangers managed just four hits while losing their third game in a row. Jacob Latz (3-4) served up Semien's homer. Red Sox 1, Guardians 0 Andruw Monasterio's sixth-inning RBI single and Sonny Gray's six shutout innings propelled Boston past visiting Cleveland. The Red Sox managed the lone run on 12 hits, all singles. They went 1-for-9 with runners in scoring position and left eight men on base through five innings before Monasterio's run-scoring single broke the deadlock. Gray (18-5), who allowed four hits, increased his AL-leading win total. Cleveland starter Foster Griffin (15-6) worked six frames, allowing one run on 10 hits. The Guardians remained tied with the White Sox atop the AL Central. Royals 5, White Sox 4 Maikel Garcia's tiebreaking double in the seventh inning capped a three-hit, three-RBI night as Kansas City beat visiting Chicago. While the Royals snapped a five-game skid, the White Sox missed a chance to regain control of the AL Central and clinch a playoff berth. Connor Thomas (2-1) tossed two shutout innings for the win, and Steven Cruz recorded his eighth save. Kansas City's Carter Jensen and Chicago's Braden Montgomery each had three hits and a run. Braves 3, Reds 2 (10 innings) Mauricio Dubon's infield chopper to the mound in the 10th inning gave host Atlanta a walk-off victory over Cincinnati. Braves starter Chris Sale pitched 5 2/3 innings and allowed one run while striking out 10, reaching 200 strikeouts for the ninth time in his career. Matt Olson and Austin Riley homered for Atlanta, and Brent Suter (3-2) tossed a perfect top of the 10th. Juan Brito led off the game with a home run, and he and Matt McLain each had two hits for the Reds. Cincinnati starter Andrew Abbott fired a season-high seven innings and allowed two runs. Orioles 4, Blue Jays 2 (Game 1) Baltimore's Pete Alonso hit another home run and the Orioles eliminated visiting Toronto from playoff contention by winning in the first game of a doubleheader. The Blue Jays were the reigning American League champions, but they won't have a chance to return to the World Series. Chris Bassitt (9-5) pitched five-plus innings to notch a victory in his third consecutive start. He gave up two runs on seven hits. Max Scherzer (3-9) surrendered four runs and four hits in five innings. Orioles 4, Blue Jays 2 (Game 2) Christian Encarnacion-Strand homered and drove in three runs and Trey Gibson took a shutout into the seventh inning as Baltimore completed a doubleheader sweep of visiting Toronto to stay in playoff contention. Baltimore must win its remaining three games and have the White Sox lose their remaining four in order to have a chance for an AL wild-card spot. Gibson (2-3), a rookie who hadn't pitched in the major leagues since June 30, gave up three hits in 6 2/3 innings. Davis Schneider hit a two-run ninth-inning homer off Felix Bautista in the nightcap for the Blue Jays. Toronto rookie starter CJ Van Eyk (0-2) allowed four runs on four hits in five innings. Yankees 9, Rays 2 Ryan McMahon hit a third-inning grand slam and tied a career high with five RBIs while Ben Rice hit a pair of solo homers as host New York rolled past Tampa Bay. McMahon drove in five runs for the fourth time in his career. Rice homered on the first pitch of the contest to become the 13th Yankee with 40 homers in a season. He later hit his 41st. Gerrit Cole (10-9) allowed two runs on three hits in 5 2/3 innings. Jonny DeLuca hit an RBI double and Cedric Mullins homered for the Rays. Mason Englert (0-4) allowed eight runs on nine hits over 3 2/3 innings. Nationals 4, Tigers 2 Yohandy Morales hit a two-run homer and visiting Washington held on for a victory over Detroit as the Nationals won the three-game series 2-1. Brady House had two hits and scored a run while CJ Abrams, who homered twice on Tuesday, reached base three times and knocked in a run for Washington. Will Dion (2-2) tossed two innings of one-run relief, and Yovanny Cruz got four outs for his first career save. Detroit starter Framber Valdez (10-12) gave up two runs and four hits over 5 1/3 innings. Ben Malgeri homered and drove in both of the Tigers' runs, and Kevin McGonigle added three hits. Twins 4, Giants 2 Pinch hitter Walker Jenkins broke a seventh-inning tie with an RBI single as Minnesota completed a 4-3 road trip with a win over San Francisco. Luke Keaschall drove in two runs with a homer and a sacrifice fly while Josh Bell added an RBI single for the Twins. Yoendrys Gomez (3-4) threw 1 2/3 innings of scoreless relief, and Andrew Morris escaped a ninth-inning jam for his fifth save. Shay Whitcomb had two hits for the Giants, who have lost five out of six. Reliever Dylan Smith (0-6) yielded two runs while getting just two outs. Cardinals 5, Pirates 1 Matthew Liberatore struck out six over 5 2/3 innings and JJ Wetherholt had three hits and an RBI to lead St. Louis to a victory at Pittsburgh. Liberatore (6-14) allowed only one run -- on a solo homer by Brandon Lowe -- as the Cardinals snapped the Pirates' season-high-tying five-game winning streak. St. Louis' Jose Fermin went 2-for-4. Lowe had two hits and Ryan O'Hearn added two doubles for Pittsburgh. Pirates reliever Brandon Eisert (3-3) gave up three runs in two-thirds of an inning. Athletics 7, Angels 3 Rookie Henry Bolte recorded the first four-hit game of his career and Donovan Walton hit a three-run homer to help the Athletics top Los Angeles in West Sacramento, Calif. Shea Langeliers had a two-run double and Bolte scored twice, had two doubles and drove in one run for the A's, who assured they will avoid a 100-loss season. Geoff Hartlieb (2-1) threw 1 2/3 innings of scoreless relief. Mike Trout and Vaughn Grissom homered for the Angels, who are two losses shy of the first 100-loss season in franchise history. Walbert Urena (9-11) allowed five runs and seven hits over four innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: Volkswagen opens presales of second Xpeng joint model in China
item.description: Volkswagen launched presales of its second model jointly developed with EV maker Xpeng in China on Thursday, expanding its electric vehicle offensive to catch up with Chinese rivals.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) launched presales of its second model jointly developed with EV maker Xpeng (9868.HK) in China on Thursday, expanding its electric vehicle offensive to catch up with Chinese rivals. The new electric fastback sedan debuts as the German auto giant battles a deepening [USN:L8N45D0E6 TEXT:"crisis"] in its largest market, driven by weaker sales and slimmer profit margins. The model, ID. UNYX 09, is the latest offering in Volkswagen's "in China, for China" campaign, which aims to accelerate vehicle development and better compete with domestic carmakers like BYD (002594.SZ) or Geely (0175.HK) . Volkswagen's partnership with Xpeng has been central to its China revamp strategy to fend off swift electrification, which led to the launch of its first Xpeng model, the [USN:L4N3ZY02V TEXT:"ID. UNYX 08"] SUV, earlier this year. Despite that push, Volkswagen's deliveries to China fell 26% to 971,000 units in the first half of 2026, the company said in July, noting it was "unable to escape" the significant decline in the Chinese market. That was their lowest level in 16 years. NEW SEDAN BROUGHT TO PRODUCTION IN JUST TWO YEARS The current contraction in the Chinese market was equivalent to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, Volkswagen's [USN:L1N45E07N TEXT:"China chief"] said this week. It has said the ID. UNYX 09 has been brought to production in just 24 months, about 30% faster, on its new China-based architecture. The mid- to large-size EV coupe is equipped with batteries from CATL (300750.SZ) , and Xpeng's VLA intelligent driving assistance system. It will be built at Volkswagen's Hefei plant, west of Shanghai, which also produces the ID. UNYX 08. Priced from 199,900 yuan ($29,785) in presales, the new sedan will officially go on sale at the end of October. In China, homegrown brands continue to erode the market share the German giant once held. Volkswagen plans to launch more than 20 battery-electric and plug-in hybrid models this year. Volkswagen has partnered up with Xpeng since 2023 when it bought a 5% stake in the Chinese firm. Expanding beyond its work with Volkswagen, Xpeng plans to offer its technology to other foreign automakers, Reuters [USN:L4N4590C9 TEXT:"exclusively"] reported this month. ($1 = 6.7115 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Norway central bank raises interest rate, may hike again
item.description: Norway's central bank raised its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.50% on Thursday as expected by a narrow majority of analysts in a Reuters poll, and said it may hike again to contain inflation.
item.dc:creator: Nerijus Adomaitis, Terje Solsvik
item.content:encoded: Norway's central bank raised its policy interest rate by 25 basis points to 4.50% on Thursday [USN:L8N4590XO TEXT:"as expected"] by a narrow majority of analysts in a Reuters poll, and said it may hike again to contain inflation. "It will likely be necessary to keep the policy rate elevated for a time, and the committee is prepared to raise the policy rate further if needed to bring inflation down to the 2% target within a reasonable time horizon," Norges Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache said in a statement. The Norwegian crown strengthened to 10.76 against the euro at 0806 GMT, from 10.79 just before the announcement. Norway's central bank [USN:L8N41K0Q6 TEXT:"raised"] rates by 25 basis points in May, moving sooner than most analysts had expected, but [USN:L8N44A0MO TEXT:"said in August"] that the future path of monetary policy would "depend on economic developments", casting some doubt on the way forward. "The committee does not want to restrict the economy more than needed, but judges that a somewhat tighter monetary policy stance is needed to return inflation to target within a reasonable time horizon," Norges Bank said on Thursday. Among the 28 economists in the [USN:L8N4590XO TEXT:"September 17-21 poll"], 16 expected Norges Bank to announce a 25 basis-point hike to 4.50%on Thursday, while 12 predicted no change at this time. A further seven economists predicted that a hike to 4.50% would come in the fourth quarter, and the vast majority of the economists polled predicted 4.50% to be the peak borrowing cost. The Nordic country's core inflation [USN:L8N4590XO TEXT:"rose to 3.0%"] year-on-year in August, below Norges Bank's official forecast of 3.3% for the 12-month period but still remaining above the central bank's target. "Over the summer, underlying inflation moderated and was lower than expected. But the inflation outlook somewhat further ahead does not appear to have changed materially," Bache said in the statement. With the new policy rate path, inflation is projected to slow from next year and move down to 2% in 2029, the central bank said. "The economy is expected to cool somewhat further, and registered unemployment is projected to edge up to slightly above pre-pandemic levels," it added.

item.title: Niger increases stake in Madaouela uranium project to 40%, statement says
item.description: Niger increased its stake in the Madaouela uranium project to 40% from 20%, bringing an end to its dispute with Australian explorer Atomic Eagle , the West African country's mining ministry said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Niger increased its stake in the Madaouela uranium project to 40% from 20%, bringing an end to its dispute with Australian explorer Atomic Eagle (AEU.AX) , the West African country's mining ministry said on Wednesday. Niger is a major uranium producer. In 2016, it awarded a permit to exploit uranium at the Madaouela project located in the Agadez region to Atomic Eagle, formerly named GoviEx. [USN:L1N3IX06M TEXT:"In 2024"], Niger revoked the miner's permit for the Madaouela uranium project and returned the asset to the state, prompting the company to file for international arbitration. The parties agreed in February 2025 to suspend the proceedings while pursuing a negotiated settlement and, in September 2025, extended the pause by a further six months to allow talks to continue, Atomic Eagle said. According to the new agreement that was signed with the mines ministry, Atomic Eagle, which is responsible for operational oversight, will now hold 60% of the project, down from 80%. Atomic Eagle did not immediately respond to a request for comment. "Niger has prioritized dialogue and negotiation to usher in a new phase based on partnership and development," a statement from the mines ministry said, without detailing the terms. Military-led governments across the Sahel region are trying to assert more control over their resources in a bid to generate more revenue.

item.title: España registra su mayor alza en precios industriales en agosto desde diciembre de 2022
item.description: Los precios industriales españoles subieron un 13,2% en los 12 meses hasta agosto, tras un aumento del 9,4% en los 12 meses hasta julio, según informó el jueves el Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los precios industriales españoles subieron un 13,2% en los 12 meses hasta agosto, tras un aumento del 9,4% en los 12 meses hasta julio, según informó el jueves el Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE). El aumento de agosto fue el mayor desde diciembre de 2022, cuando alcanzó el 14,9%, según los datos del INE. La subida se debió principalmente al incremento de los precios del refino de petróleo y del gas. El INE revisó al alza la cifra de julio, que inicialmente se situaba en un aumento del 9,2%. En términos intermensuales, los precios industriales subieron un 2,9% en agosto con respecto a julio, según el INE. Las empresas tienden a repercutir las subidas de los precios industriales a los clientes, lo que, en última instancia, impulsa la inflación. La tasa de inflación interanual de España armonizada con la de la Unión Europea —una de las principales medidas de los aumentos de precios a nivel nacional, diseñada para ser comparable entre los Estados miembros de la UE—, subió al 4,6% en agosto, frente al 3,9% registrado en el periodo hasta julio.

item.title: BoE's Lombardelli sees rates rising if energy prices stay high
item.description: Bank of England Deputy Governor Clare Lombardelli said on Thursday that interest rates will likely have to rise if energy prices stay elevated, unless there is clear evidence of a weaker economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bank of England Deputy Governor Clare Lombardelli said on Thursday that interest rates will likely have to rise if energy prices stay elevated, unless there is clear evidence of a weaker economy. Lombardelli, deputy governor in charge of monetary policy, last week said the case for an increase in interest rates was building, as she voted with a 6-3 [USN:L8N4590W3 TEXT:"majority in favour"] of holding them at 3.75%. "The longer higher energy prices persist, the greater the risk that indirect effects build and that inflation expectations, wage bargaining and price-setting behaviour begin to adjust in response," Lombardelli said in a speech given at the Sixth Biennial Conference on Macroeconomic Policy, Warsaw. "On that basis, policy is increasingly likely to need to tighten if elevated energy prices persist, absent clear evidence of disinflation or weaker activity." Lombardelli added that she was not saying monetary policy should react mechanically to energy prices but instead counter the risk that they start to feed through into inflation expectations, wage bargaining and price-setting. "The key issue is not the spot price of energy itself but the interaction of the underlying economy, higher energy prices, and the nature of their transmission. That, ultimately, is what will determine whether Bank Rate needs to rise," Lombardelli said. She said monetary policy and financial conditions remained restrictive but pointed to the risk that food inflation — which has undercut the BoE's expectations — could still pick up and then raise pressure on wage-setting. Lombardelli said wage growth of around 3.25% could be consistent with the 2% inflation target in the long run — assuming 1% productivity growth and normal import price inflation — but that might not be the case if energy prices keep pushing up import costs. BoE Governor Andrew Bailey and deputy governors Sarah Breeden and Dave Ramsden also raised the prospect of raising interest rates at last week's meeting. Bailey said there was no "firm judgement" on what will happen to rates. Financial markets on Thursday pointed to a roughly 75% chance that the BoE will hike interest rates by a quarter point at its next meeting in November.

item.title: Las bolsas europeas caen ante la tensión en Oriente Medio y a la espera del diálogo EEUU-China
item.description: Las bolsas europeas bajaban ligeramente este jueves, mientras los inversores sopesaban la tensión persistente en Oriente Medio y esperaban las conversaciones previstas entre Estados Unidos y China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las bolsas europeas bajaban ligeramente este jueves, mientras los inversores sopesaban la tensión persistente en Oriente Medio y esperaban las conversaciones previstas entre Estados Unidos y China. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) descendía un 0,4%, hasta los 637,56 puntos, a las 0710 GMT. La mayoría de las bolsas regionales también cotizaban a la baja. La confianza de los inversores seguía cautelosa, en un momento en que la tensión geopolítica en Oriente Medio mantenía la volatilidad en los mercados energéticos. Responsables iraníes mantuvieron una comunicación con enviados estadounidenses en la Asamblea General de la ONU, pero ambas partes indicaron que se habían logrado pocos avances para poner fin al conflicto. Los precios del petróleo avanzaban ligeramente al reevaluar los operadores los riesgos de suministro vinculados al conflicto de Oriente Medio, y los futuros del crudo Brent se mantenían por encima del nivel clave de los 100 dólares por barril. Las acciones del sector energético europeo (.SXEP) se anotaban un 0,3%, mientras que los valores aeroespaciales y de defensa (.SXPARO) lideraban las caídas sectoriales, lastrados por Saab (SAABb.ST) y Hensoldt (HAGG.DE) . La cumbre entre el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, y el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, también está en el foco de atención, con la esperanza de que se produzcan avances en las relaciones comerciales. Entre los valores individuales, Shelly Group avanzaba un 6,2% después de que Schneider (SCHN.PA) anunciara su intención de lanzar una oferta de adquisición por valor de 1.200 millones de euros (1.400 millones de dólares) sobre el fabricante búlgaro de dispositivos inteligentes. Las acciones de H&M (HMb.ST) retrocedían un 2,5% a pesar de que la cadena de moda sueca anunció un aumento mayor de lo esperado en su beneficio operativo correspondiente al periodo de junio a agosto.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der schwedische Modekonzern H&M (HMb.ST) profitiert von seinem Sparkurs und verdient mehr - kämpft aber weiterhin mit einem schwachen Umsatzwachstum. Der operative Gewinn stieg im Zeitraum von Juni bis August auf 6,04 Milliarden schwedische Kronen nach 4,91 Milliarden Kronen im Vorjahreszeitraum, wie das Unternehmen am Donnerstag mitteilte. Analysten hatten im Schnitt mit einem geringeren Gewinn von 5,14 Milliarden Kronen gerechnet. Die Erlöse blieben jedoch hinter den Erwartungen zurück. Für den September prognostiziert H&M ein Umsatzplus von einem Prozent in lokalen Währungen, was dem Wachstum des vergangenen Quartals entspricht. Die Aktie verlor zur Eröffnung zwei Prozent. Seit dem Amtsantritt von Konzernchef Daniel Erver im Januar 2024 liegt der Schwerpunkt bei den Schweden verstärkt auf der Profitabilität. Investoren warten jedoch auch auf eine Belebung des Geschäfts, da H&M unter dem Druck von Konkurrenten wie Shein und der Zara-Mutter Inditex (ITX.MC) steht. Die Bruttomarge verbesserte sich unter anderem wegen der Rückerstattung von Zöllen auf 54,0 Prozent nach 52,9 Prozent im Vorjahr. Die Lagerbestände erhöhten sich währungsbereinigt um neun Prozent, was der Konzern auf Störungen in den globalen Lieferketten zurückführte. Um schneller auf Modetrends reagieren zu können, kauft H&M verstärkt Kleidung innerhalb der laufenden Saison ein und investiert zudem in neue Logistikzentren in Europa. Jüngst bauten die milliardenschweren Erben des H&M-Gründers Erling Persson ihren Anteil an dem Konzern weiter aus und befeuerten damit Spekulationen, dass sie die Modekette von der Börse nehmen könnten: Ende August kontrollierten sie über 68 Prozent der Anteile.

item.content:encoded: Die führenden Wirtschaftsforschungsinstitute erwarten noch dieses Jahr weiter steigende Zinsen im Euroraum. Sie rechnen in ihrem am Donnerstag vorgelegten Herbstgutachten damit, dass die Europäische Zentralbank (EZB) die Leitzinsen im Dezember zum dritten Mal im laufenden Jahr anheben wird. Bei einer Erhöhung um einen Viertelpunkt dürfte der für die Geldpolitik relevante Einlagensatz dann bei 2,75  Prozent liegen. "Dem dürften die Zinssätze an den Geldmärkten folgen", heißt es in der sogenannten Gemeinschaftsdiagnose der Institute. Im Zuge anziehender Energiepreise und gestiegener kurzfristiger Inflationserwartungen hatte der EZB-Rat um Präsidentin Christine Lagarde den Leitzins im Juni und im September um je 0,25 Prozentpunkte angehoben - auf aktuell 2,50  Prozent. Die Teuerungsrate im Euroraum war im August auf 3,2 Prozent gestiegen. Wegen des Iran-Krieges und der damit verbundenen höheren Benzin- und Gaspreise rechnen einige Experten bis zum Jahresende mit einem Anstieg auf vier Prozent. Der Preisschub bei Energie hat an den Finanzmärkten die Wetten auf weitere Zinserhöhungen angeheizt. Dabei wird auch darüber spekuliert, ob die EZB bereits Ende Oktober den nächsten Schritt nach oben machen könnte. Das österreichische EZB-Ratsmitglied Martin [USN:L8N45G0BE TEXT:"Kocher"] schließt weitere Zinserhöhungen im Kampf gegen die Inflation nicht aus und verweist dabei auf die robuste Konjunktur im Euroraum. Die EZB werde angesichts der großen Unsicherheit, auch durch den Preisschock im Nahen und Mittleren Osten, die Situation bei jeder Sitzung neu bewerten, sagte er der Tageszeitung "Kurier".

item.title: Suisse-La BNS maintient son taux à 0% malgré la hausse de l'inflation
item.description: La Banque nationale suisse (BNS) a maintenu jeudi son principal taux directeur au niveau actuel malgré l'accélération de l'inflation provoquée par la guerre au Moyen-Orient, qui a conduit d'autres banques centrales à relever leurs coûts d'emprunt.
item.dc:creator: John Revill
item.content:encoded: La Banque nationale suisse (BNS) a maintenu jeudi son principal taux directeur au niveau actuel malgré l'accélération de l'inflation provoquée par la guerre au Moyen-Orient, qui a conduit d'autres banques centrales à relever leurs coûts d'emprunt. Ce taux reste ainsi fixé à 0%, le niveau le plus bas parmi les grandes banques centrales dans le monde. Il est à ce seuil depuis juin 2025, malgré une accélération de l'inflation en Suisse, qui a grimpé à un pic de deux ans. L'inflation en Suisse s'est établie à 0,8% sur un an en août, en raison principalement de la flambée des prix des carburants depuis le déclenchement de la guerre israélo-américaine contre l'Iran le 28 février. La BNS vise un objectif d'inflation dans une fourchette de 0% à 2%, présentée par la banque centrale comme compatible avec une stabilité des prix. La majorité des économistes interrogés par Reuters prévoyait un maintien des taux ce jeudi, tandis que les marchés financiers anticipaient avec une probabilité de 94% un statu quo sur le loyer de l'argent. "La pression inflationniste à moyen terme ne s'est que légèrement accentuée. La politique monétaire de la Banque nationale est appropriée pour maintenir l'inflation dans la plage de stabilité des prix et soutient l'activité", écrit la BNS dans son communiqué de politique monétaire. La banque centrale se dit par ailleurs disposée à intervenir activement sur le marché des changes si nécessaire afin de garantir des conditions monétaires adéquates, ce qui marque un léger changement par rapport à la dernière réunion. Auparavant, elle avait indiqué être davantage disposée à intervenir sur le marché des changes pour contrer une appréciation excessive du franc. La devise suisse s'est dépréciée face à l'euro et au dollar ces dernières semaines. Le franc suisse s'est légèrement affaibli après la décision de la BNS, pour s'échanger quasiment stable face à l'euro à 0,9395 franc et à 0,8247 franc face au dollar américain .

item.title: German business morale rises more than expected in September, Ifo finds
item.description: German business morale rose more than expected in September, a survey showed on Thursday, signalling that Europe's largest economy is weathering an energy price shock that has pushed fuel costs to record highs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German business morale rose more than expected in September, a survey showed on Thursday, signalling that Europe's largest economy is weathering an energy price shock that has pushed fuel costs to record highs. The Ifo institute said its business climate index rose to 89.9 in September from 88.8 in [USN:S8N41J07N TEXT:"August"]. Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast an increase to 89.0. The reading is the third piece of evidence this week that a long-awaited recovery is taking hold. It follows [USN:L6N45F0C1 TEXT:"flash PMI"] data on Wednesday showing German business activity expanding at its fastest pace in almost a year. Also, the country's five leading economic institutes presented a joint autumn forecast that raised 2026 growth expectations to 1.3% from 0.6%. Ifo's gauge of expectations rose to 90.4 from 89.1 in August, while companies' assessment of their current situation improved to 89.5 from 88.5, the institute said. Any pickup would be welcome for Chancellor Friedrich Merz, whose conservatives scored their worst state election result since 1949 in [USN:L1N45C01D TEXT:"Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania"] on Sunday as voters punished the government in part because of rising living costs. Merz's government has decided to cut [USN:L8N45A15I TEXT:"fuel taxes"] by €0.17 ($0.19) a litre from October 1 until the end of the year.

item.content:encoded: Trotz der anziehenden Inflation tastet die Schweizerische Nationalbank (SNB) die Zinsen nicht an. Der SNB-Leitzins bleibe unverändert bei null Prozent, teilte die Notenbank am Donnerstag mit. Dies ist das niedrigste Niveau aller größeren Währungsräume. Von der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters im Vorfeld der vierteljährlichen geldpolitischen Lagebeurteilung befragte Ökonomen hatten einhellig prognostiziert, dass die Notenbanker an dem seit Juni 2025 bestehenden Niveau festhalten dürften. Bei Bedarf sei die Nationalbank zudem bereit, am Devisenmarkt aktiv zu sein, um angemessene monetäre Bedingungen zu gewährleisten. Zuletzt hatte der Franken zum Euro und zum Dollar an Wert verloren. Zwar beschleunigte sich die Inflation in der Schweiz im August auf 0,8 Prozent – den höchsten Stand seit zwei Jahren –, getrieben durch steigende Treibstoffpreise infolge des Iran-Konflikts. Die Teuerung liegt damit jedoch weiterhin deutlich innerhalb des Zielbereichs der SNB von null bis zwei Prozent, den die Notenbank als Preisstabilität definiert. Gemäß der bedingten Inflationsprognose werde die Inflation im vierten Quartal noch etwas ansteigen, bevor sie im Verlauf des Jahres 2027 wieder zurückgehe, so die SNB. Dieser Rückgang sei darauf zurückzuführen, dass die aktuell deutlich erhöhte Teuerung bei der Energie in den kommenden Quartalen wieder sinken dürfte. In ihrer neuen Prognose geht die SNB davon aus, dass die Inflation im Jahr 2026 bei 0,7 Prozent liegen wird (zuvor: 0,6 Prozent). Für 2027 prognostiziert die Notenbank eine Teuerung von 0,8 Prozent (Juni-Prognose: 0,6 Prozent) und für 2028 von 0,8 Prozent (zuvor: 0,7 Prozent). Das Wirtschaftswachstum in der Schweiz soll in diesem Jahr 1,5 bis zwei Prozent betragen (zuvor: rund ein Prozent). Für 2027 erwartet die SNB unverändert ein Wachstum von 1,5 Prozent. Mit der Zinspause unterscheidet sich die SNB von anderen großen Notenbanken. Die Europäische Zentralbank (EZB) hatte die Zinsen Anfang des Monats angehoben. Zudem erhöhte die US-Notenbank Federal Reserve die Kreditkosten und signalisierte weitere Schritte.

item.title: Turkish finance minister to hold meetings on fund liquidation crisis, state media says
item.description: Turkish Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek will hold a series of meetings on Thursday and Friday to discuss the process of the liquidation of 131 investment funds worth around $18 billion, the state-run Anadolu news agency said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkish Finance Minister Mehmet Simsek will hold a series of meetings on Thursday and Friday to discuss the process of the liquidation of 131 investment funds worth around $18 billion, the state-run Anadolu news agency said. Turkish authorities took steps last week to support [USN:L1N45907O TEXT:"financial stability"] after some [USN:L6N45E09B TEXT:"investment funds"] failed to meet withdrawals from almost half a million investors amid a selloff in the country's stock market. The measures included steps to boost lira liquidity and ease some capital and margin requirements. The liquidity crisis, triggered by suspected share price manipulation in thinly traded stocks, has shaken confidence in Turkey's investment fund sector and prompted a sweeping regulatory crackdown and investigation with dozens of people —including fund managers and senior executives — [USN:L6N45E09B TEXT:"arrested or detained."] Anadolu said Simsek would hold the meetings after returning from New York, where he attended the UN General Assembly with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, and added they would look into technical work on the liquidation of the funds and payments to investors, with officials from relevant institutions and organisations also participating. It said the main priority of the meetings would be to preserve the rights and interests of investors, to ensure the healthy functioning of markets and to discuss steps that may be taken to support financial stability. Coordination among various institutions and a technical roadmap will also be on the agenda, it added. Finance ministry spokespeople were not immediately available for comment.

item.title: German institutes raise 2026 and 2027 economic growth forecasts
item.description: Germany's leading economic institutes raised their forecasts for growth in Europe's largest economy for this year and next on Thursday, noting that the economy performed significantly better in the first half of 2026 than had been expected in the spring.
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez
item.content:encoded: Germany's leading economic institutes raised their forecasts for growth in Europe's largest economy for this year and next on Thursday, noting that the economy performed significantly better in the first half of 2026 than had been expected in the spring. The German economy is forecast to grow 1.3% in 2026, compared with an earlier forecast of 0.6%. For 2027, the institutes forecast growth of 1.1%, up from an earlier projection of 0.9%. The numbers confirm a [USN:L1N45E0BV TEXT:"Reuters report"] from Tuesday. "The economy has developed more robustly than expected. However, the recovery rests on a narrow foundation, as high energy prices and struc­tural problems continue to weigh on economic activity,” said Oliver Holtemoeller at the Halle Institute for Economic Research (IWH). The German economy has been recovering since the end of 2025 but the rebound, although stronger than expected in the spring, remains modest, the institutes said. The institutes expect growth of only 0.4% in 2028. Economic expansion is expected to lose momentum in 2028 as it will be constrained by structural factors: the labour force is shrinking due to demographic change, and potential growth continues to decline, the economists said. Germany's sluggish economy has been a big issue in the country's [USN:L8N45C0DZ TEXT:"recent regional elections"] that have resulted in big gains for the far right and far left. Economic recovery temporarily slowed in the third quarter, the institutes said. While sentiment indicators continue to improve, the latest hard economic data have come in weaker. Although the energy price shock associated with the Iran war has weighed on the economy, higher prices for motor fuels and heating oil have so far had little spillover effect on broader con­sumer prices, the economists said. However, the institutes forecast inflation rising to 2.8% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027, before falling to 2.0% in 2028. The labour market is likely to respond only with a lag: employment is expected to decline further for the time being, while the unemployment rate is expected to fall from 6.4% in 2026 to 6.2% in 2027 and 5.8% in 2028. The forecasts are made jointly by five prominent economic institutes - RWI in Essen, the Ifo institute in Munich, IfW in Kiel, IWH in Halle and DIW in Berlin.

item.title: Meta presenta Charm, un dispositivo de IA, en la búsqueda del sucesor del "smartphone"
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg, director ejecutivo de Meta , presentó el miércoles un pequeño dispositivo portátil llamado Meta Charm para utilizar su nuevo asistente de IA, Muse, con lo que amplía los esfuerzos de la empresa en materia de hardware más allá de sus exitosas gafas inteligentes.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: Mark Zuckerberg, director ejecutivo de Meta (META.O) , presentó el miércoles un pequeño dispositivo portátil llamado Meta Charm para utilizar su nuevo asistente de IA, Muse, con lo que amplía los esfuerzos de la empresa en materia de hardware más allá de sus exitosas gafas inteligentes. El dispositivo de IA, del tamaño aproximado de un estuche de AirPods de Apple, cuenta con una pantalla táctil de unas 2 pulgadas y conexión 5G integrada. Meta ha afirmado que el Charm estará listo para su envío para las fiestas de diciembre, aunque no ha revelado su precio. "Hemos condensado toda la experiencia de Muse, incluyendo todo el conjunto de funciones de voz y avatares en tiempo real, en algo que cabe en un llavero y con el que siempre se puede hablar", dijo Zuckerberg en el evento anual de dispositivos de Meta, Meta Connect, celebrado en Menlo Park, California. El anuncio sorpresa de Meta llega en un momento en que Silicon Valley busca un sucesor del teléfono inteligente, invirtiendo miles de millones en dispositivos diseñados en torno a asistentes de IA capaces de ver, oír y responder al mundo que los rodea. Desde gafas inteligentes y pines hasta dispositivos de mano, las empresas apuestan por que la IA transformará la forma en que los consumidores interactúan con la tecnología. Aún no está claro qué formato acabará imponiéndose como estándar. La propia Meta comenzó con las gafas con IA, convirtiendo su colaboración con Ray-Ban, de EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) , en uno de los primeros éxitos en esa categoría. El miércoles, el gigante de las redes sociales también presentó su primer dispositivo de realidad virtual, lo suficientemente delgado como para pasar por unas gafas, y un par de gafas inteligentes sin cámara diseñadas para mitigar el creciente rechazo por motivos de privacidad que suscitan los dispositivos de IA capaces de grabar vídeos y tomar fotografías de las personas sin su consentimiento. LOS DISPOSITIVOS DE META CONTARÁN CON MUSE La empresa también ha ampliado su asistente de inteligencia artificial viral, Muse, a toda su gama de gafas inteligentes, añadiendo nuevas capacidades, como el uso de computadores y la integración con minoristas y servicios como Walmart (WMT.O) , Best Buy (BBY.N) y Gap (GAP.N) . Meta ha afirmado que Muse se convertirá en la interfaz principal de sus gafas, lo que permitirá a los usuarios comprar, concertar citas y realizar tareas mediante comandos de voz. Las gafas Meta VR, con un precio de 1.299 dólares, pretenden igualar las prestaciones de rivales más voluminosos y costosos, como las Vision Pro de Apple. El dispositivo pesa aproximadamente lo mismo que una baraja de cartas, un diseño posible gracias a que la batería y el procesador se han trasladado a una unidad separada. Su lanzamiento está previsto para la primavera de 2027. Meta apuesta por que este dispositivo de realidad virtual, que tiene el aspecto de unas gafas envolventes oscuras y responde a gestos oculares, de voz y de las manos, pueda finalmente llevar al gran público una categoría que durante mucho tiempo se ha visto frenada por los altos precios y los pesados cascos, incómodos de llevar durante horas. "Reducir el peso a unos 100 gramos es impresionante y podría mejorar la experiencia del usuario", dijo Linda Sui, fundadora de Smart Analytics Group, una empresa de estudios de mercado. "Sin embargo, los principales casos de uso siguen siendo, en líneas generales, similares a los de los cascos de realidad virtual anteriores. El precio más elevado también podría dificultar su llegada al gran público." Las nuevas gafas sin cámara, denominadas Ray-Ban Meta Audio, seguirán grabando audio y no indicarán claramente a los transeúntes que se está realizando una grabación, a diferencia de sus gafas inteligentes con cámara, que emiten un destello de luz mientras graban. Los críticos afirman que el mero hecho de prescindir de las cámaras podría no ser suficiente para disipar las preocupaciones sobre la privacidad. Las gafas Meta Audio son el nuevo modelo fabricado a través de la colaboración de la empresa con EssilorLuxottica y saldrán a la venta a partir del 13 de octubre a un precio inicial de 349 dólares. Esto supone 100 dólares menos que la última versión de sus gafas Ray-Ban, que siguen incorporando cámaras y estarán disponibles en dos nuevos modelos: las icónicas Aviator y las Zena, de ojo de gato.

item.content:encoded: Der vor wenigen Monaten [USN:L8N41P1GK TEXT:"geschasste"] Chef von Delivery Hero (DHER.DE) bleibt nun doch im Amt. Niklas Östberg werde das Unternehmen über den 31.
